entity.name: GlobeDoc Research Hub
entity.description: GlobeDoc Research Hub is a Swedish non-profit research association (ideell förening, org. no. 802558-6366, EU PIC 860142845) developing GPOC – the Global Patient co-Owned Cloud: a free, open-source health record that belongs to the patient and follows each person across borders and over a lifetime. The hub is volunteer-run and supported by an international network of academic Fellows in AI, health data governance and ethics.

projects.name: GlobeDoc (GPOC)
projects.description: A free, open-source, patient co-owned health record. Patients own their health passport (history, medications, allergies, vaccinations, records and files) and grant healthcare professionals time-limited, consent-based access through pairing codes. Built with Row Level Security, data export and full account deletion, and an interface in 26 languages. Research prototype aiming for recognition as a Digital Public Good.

channels.description: Bank transfer to GlobeDoc Research Hub's account in Sweden. Account details on request: admin@globedoc.com

plans.name: Development and maintenance
plans.description: Core development, maintenance and documentation of the open-source GlobeDoc app towards production readiness.

plans.name: Independent security audit
plans.description: An external security and privacy audit of the codebase before any use with real patient data.

history.description: Association registered in November 2026. Development to date has been volunteer-funded.
